title: Liking: The Friendly Thief
coreMove: Separate warmth toward the messenger from the merits of the decision.
sourcePressure: The source centers liking as compliance leverage through physical attractiveness, halo effect, similarity, praise, contact, cooperation, association, celebrity endorsement, sports identification, and the defense of judging the deal apart from the person.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Do not turn this into friendship advice; liking is the cue that can steal judgment from the actual offer.

hook: Friendly people can still sell you something
You like the person, not the deal
counterintuition: Do not trust people you like
tryThisNow: Ask whether you like the deal

exampleSpecs.audience: a parent choosing a violin rental plan
exampleSpecs.stakes: overpaying because the rep praises the child's musical ear
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the parent smiles at the compliment, then covers the rep's handwritten note and compares the monthly terms alone
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a half-size violin case with a frayed shoulder strap

exampleSpecs.domain: running shoe fitting at a specialty shop
exampleSpecs.audience: a new marathon trainee who meets a clerk from the same hometown
exampleSpecs.stakes: buying shoes based on similarity instead of fit
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: after the hometown connection, the runner asks to rerun the gait test with two unlabeled shoes
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a treadmill belt ticking under fluorescent lights

exampleSpecs.audience: a member voting for board candidates
exampleSpecs.stakes: choosing a charming candidate whose budget plan is weaker
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the member rereads the candidate statements after removing the headshots from the packet
exampleSpecs.firstImage: candidate headshots clipped to a clipboard by the bulk bins

exampleSpecs.audience: a volunteer deciding whether to waive a late fee
exampleSpecs.stakes: letting association with a famous actor override the rules
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the guest mentions the actor twice, and the volunteer points back to the same fee policy used for everyone
exampleSpecs.firstImage: laminated festival badges fanned across a folding table

exampleSpecs.audience: a homeowner evaluating a contractor endorsed by a beloved neighbor
exampleSpecs.stakes: signing because neighbor warmth transfers to the contractor
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the homeowner writes two columns, what I feel about Lena and what the warranty actually promises
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a roof photo projected onto a church basement wall

exampleSpecs.audience: a couple choosing between two dogs
exampleSpecs.stakes: ignoring behavior constraints because the volunteer is warm and reassuring
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the couple notices the volunteer's warmth calming them and asks to test the dog's leash behavior before deciding
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a nylon leash looped around a kennel latch

skillTargets: spot when similarity or praise is carrying a request
separate messenger warmth from offer quality
detect association effects without becoming cynical
choose a fair test that preserves the relationship

tryThisNowSpec: Take one appealing recommendation you received recently and write two words over it: person and proposal. Judge the proposal under the second word.
